title: ESA 2026 — Aquatic Ecology Guide
text:
Salt Lake City, UT | July 26–30, 2026 | All times MDT
This site filters the ESA 2026 Annual Meeting program down to talks, posters, and sessions relevant to aquatic ecology — marine, coastal, wetlands, lakes, rivers/streams, estuaries, freshwater, and closely related topics (fish/fisheries, kelp, coral reefs, riparian zones, limnology, and more).
Two views are provided:

Detailed Schedule — every individual talk or poster that matches, sorted by date, time, room, and title/author. Use this to build your personal itinerary.
High-Level Sessions — every full session block relevant to aquatic ecology: Contributed Oral/Poster Session “buckets” with an aquatic title (e.g. COS 015 - Aquatic Ecology: Streams And Rivers, PP 18 - Wetlands), plus Symposia, Special Sessions, Organized Oral Sessions, Workshops, and Inspire Sessions with substantial aquatic content. Use this to find full rooms/blocks worth planning your day around.

Both lists were generated by parsing the official ESA program export and matching on session and talk titles; entries marked “CANCELLED” in the original program are left as-is.
